title: Report data quality and make the pipeline operable by someone else
problem: A pipeline that only its author can operate, and whose output nobody can check, will be trusted until it is wrong and then abandoned. The people downstream need to know what the data does not contain before they rely on it.
context: Final task of the pack. This is where the pipeline becomes something another person can operate and an analyst can trust or question.
impact: The quality report is the pipeline's account of itself. Without it, every other guarantee is a claim nobody can check.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The report reconciles each batch: rows read equals loaded plus rejected plus superseded, computed from the manifest and quarantine with SQL, not re-counted from the files.

The report shows per-column null rates, duplicate keys within batches, and a change in at least one value distribution between consecutive batches, with the threshold that makes a change worth flagging.
Each report figure comes from a documented SQL query whose null handling and joins are explained in the design.
A person with only the README goes from clone to a loaded database and the quality report in under a minute.
An operations note covers a refused batch, a retried load, an interrupted load and a full rebuild.

Someone other than the learner answers a stated question about the data using only the README and the quality report, and says how confident they are and why. The result is recorded, including where they got stuck.
Automated tests cover the reconciliation and at least one quality flag, and pass at the submitted revision.
The learner explains one quality check that could pass while the data is still wrong, and the first thing that breaks when a batch is a hundred times larger.

constraints: Standard library, including sqlite3 and csv, plus a test runner only. No ORM, dataframe or validation library.
AC-outside-check requires a real person. A simulated or model-performed walkthrough does not satisfy it, and recording one as satisfied is fabricated evidence.
Do not push to a remote, publish a package or deploy anything as part of this task.

scope.description: Reconciliation, quality reporting and operability of the whole pipeline.

investigation_areas: Which quality problems the synthetic data actually contains, and whether the report finds all of them
How NULL behaves in the aggregates the report uses
Where a first-time reader of the report gets confused, which is discovered by watching one
testing_expectations: Run the project's own test suite. State the exact command in the design.
Perform the quickstart on a clean clone before claiming AC-quickstart.
documentation_requirements: README quickstart, the contract format, the winning rule and the operations note.
Record the outside check result verbatim, including where the person got stuck.
